comparison.objective: Secure a free-standing gas cylinder to a wall bracket with its chain.
comparison.physical_skill: Chain routing, link hooking, snugness selection, cylinder stabilization, and valve avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Chain hooked at the correct height and snugness, cylinder upright against the cradle, released, and resistant to a 10 N pull check.
comparison.reason: Its tested ability is wrapping and hooking a flexible restraint around a hazardous cylinder; it does not test a continuous guide-surface handoff or preservation of circulating balls.
